_comment: Declarative derivation rules for the generated project fixtures.
scripts/generate_test_projects.py reads this file and writes the derived
projects into the build tree; nothing here is committed as YAML.
Variants are processed in order and each variant's 'sources' globs are
resolved against the committed project tree first and then against the
already-generated variants, so a variant may build on an earlier one.

variants.name: stacking-captures
variants.description: Six captures of each pressing: fresh capture seeds, the pressing's shared noise untouched. Capture 2 starts later (PN 5); capture 3 replays the multi-burst range (PNs 9-12); capture 5 comes from a player with a chroma gain and phase error; capture 6 sets a whole-sample timing offset of +2 for whole-sample alignment. The others keep the pressing's channel and chroma error. Each pressing offsets its capture seeds (B by 1000, C by 2000, D by 3000), because captures of different discs never share capture noise.

variants.name: stacking-clean
variants.description: Disc-simulation sources and pressing captures with the impairment blocks removed, for reference comparisons against the noisy captures. The project-level channel block is kept: it is part of the pressing's truth.

variants.name: film-clv
variants.description: The 2:3 pulldown film fixtures on a CLV disc: the CAV picture numbers become the CLV programme time code, CLV picture number and CLV code, and the 40-bit FM picture number becomes the FM programme time.

variants.name: film-pal-m
variants.description: The 2:3 pulldown film fixtures, CAV and CLV, on PAL-M: the other 525-line standard that carries 2:3 pulldown, over the same 720x486 sources.

variants.name: stacking-yc
variants.description: Y/C (separate luma/chroma) renderings of every stacking project, composite and clean alike.
